definitions.ask: Should the footer also preview Alt+P off the walk on open tasks with no priority (`Alt+P set high`)?
definitions.why: On a no-priority task Alt+P always does what key 1 does, so the hint is noise

choices.label: No-priority rows keep `]s next` and stay hidden when nothing is due
Every open task line shows the hint, so the footer appears on any task line

definitions.ask: Should Alt+P on a no-priority task draw its date exactly like key 1, even re-picking the current date?
definitions.why: Only Blocked rows differ, never Ready ones, and a roll that always moves the date is better

choices.label: Alt+P still avoids the current date; only Blocked rows inside P1's window differ
One nav helper swap makes every row match key 1; the parity test gains an in-window row

definitions.ask: Should the review-footer glossary strand describe the off-walk Alt+P hint and the hint-only footer?
definitions.corrects: hides when nothing is due or Tasks is unavailable
